nativeOperationDecisionNeeded.constraint: Maintained Node declarations accept string argv and string/URL cwd; actual legacy runtime accepts/coerces raw argv and rejects invalid cwd at its existing operation. Strict typing cannot assert an unknown saved field is a string merely to call the declared API.
nativeOperationDecisionNeeded.preferredMinimalBoundary: Keep raw values unknown throughout first-party ownership; permit narrowly documented operation-local type assertions only at existing dynamic property invocations (cwd.startsWith/slice) and the real child_process.spawn/execFile calls whose runtime validates/coerces the values. No record/option/schema casts, fake API declarations, any, suppressions, new validation, or returned-value widening. This explicitly documents retained native input validation rather than claiming malformed fields valid.
nativeOperationDecisionNeeded.alternativeTradeoff: Implement explicit native-compatible coercion/validation in first-party code, requiring exact Node/backend error-order probes and duplicating runtime policy. Not recommended as a migration-only change.
nativeOperationDecisionNeeded.authorization: These operation-local native argument assertions are NOT applied; parent must explicitly approve or supply a stricter approach preserving the exact runtime contract. Current owner instructions prohibit casts asserting malformed saved fields valid.
